Splitting into 3 separate vaults needs a separate funded raven account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the willow binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Each impostor pays 18 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
